title: Asrār al-Ṣalāt ('The Mysteries of Ritual Prayer')

date.basis: MK: 'completed on' this date in Herat; differs from the Majlis 10196 copy (Yazd, 26 Ramaḍān 828/11 Aug 1425), so it is not merely the copy date; MK does not name the source of the 820 date. The K. al-Mafāḥiṣ (823/1420) refers to the work (f. 77a) and the R. Suʾl al-Mulūk refers to it.

place: Herat (composition, per MK); the Majlis 10196 copy was made in Yazd
manuscript: 13 copies listed; earliest dated: MS Majlis 10196 ff. 129b-39a (Yazd, 26 Ramaḍān 828/11 Aug 1425); then MS 5423 (842/1439), MS 1825 (851/1447), Bāqir Riqqat majmūʿa (901/1496), and later copies. Āqā Buzurg mis-dates the Majlis copy to 17 Dhū l-Qaʿda 828.
summary: On the symbolism and esoteric meaning of the prayer act from mystical and lettrist points of view, with attention to Shafiʿi and Hanafi legal positions.
